mechanism: hedging-pressure premium transferred to USD-M perpetuals: fast open-interest build-up marks leveraged speculative positioning pressure; the opposite side earns the premium as crowded leverage unwinds (Bessembinder 1992 / de Roon et al. 2000 mechanism; Dunbar & Owusu-Amoako 2023 crypto-specific pricing of positioning pressure)

claim_to_test_mapping.claim: the side of a futures market opposite to dominant non-speculative pressure earns a premium
claim_to_test_mapping.repo_test: sign of the weekly low-minus-high dOI book net spread on the frozen snapshot

claim_to_test_mapping.claim: futures risk premia depend on hedging pressure (abstract, verified)
claim_to_test_mapping.repo_test: anchor sign and consistency with the sign-flipped pressure control

claim_to_test_mapping.claim: hedging pressure is a systematic priced factor in futures markets
claim_to_test_mapping.repo_test: cross-fold stability of the spread (prior only; never a gate waiver)

claim_to_test_mapping.claim: the hedging factor has a statistically significant and economically important effect on crypto return predictability
claim_to_test_mapping.repo_test: same pressure mechanism re-earned on USD-M perps with venue OI as the PIT proxy (CFTC long/short splits unavailable in snapshot; transfer disclosed)

feature_contract.bars: completed 15m base bars (grid, tradability floor, beta anchor) + staged OI snapshot series + mark price
feature_contract.aggregate: OI resampled to daily UTC last-observation on the completed-bar grid
feature_contract.pressure_feature: HP = (OI_t - OI_{t-28d}) / mean(OI over trailing 28d); winsorised 1%/99% cross-sectionally
feature_contract.neighbour_feature: HP scaled by activity: dOI(28d) / mean daily dollar volume(28d)
feature_contract.residualisation: NONE for sorting (positioning-quantity sort); BTC-beta leg neutralisation only, 90d rolling daily beta convention
feature_contract.pit_lag: features from snapshots strictly before decision instant; one declared execution lag; fills strictly after decision instant; stale OI (>48h) drops the symbol fail-closed

universe_and_benchmark.universe: staged USD-M perps with >=60d OI history at formation and median daily dollar volume above staged-universe cross-sectional median (PIT tradability floor)
universe_and_benchmark.benchmark_role: BTC perp = beta anchor and A7-N orthogonality reference, context-only; scored object is the dollar-neutral long-minus-short book

schedule.turnover_control: tercile buckets with entry/exit buffer bands; expected one-way turnover ~0.25-0.35 of book per decision; equal weights with per-symbol cap 1/(2*N_bucket)
schedule.floor_precheck: 52<=60 decisions; min completed span 7d so median >=3d; worst-case full swap ~6.2%/yr base drag within 8%/12% floors; symbol turnover share guarded by weight cap

anchor.name: OI-HP-28D-W
anchor.book: long low/negative 28d dOI tercile minus short high-dOI tercile, weekly hold

neighbour.name: OI-HP-VOLSCL-28D-W
neighbour.book: same mechanism, pressure normalised by mean daily dollar volume instead of OI stock (scale-free positioning change per unit of trading activity)
neighbour.justification: hedging-pressure ratios in BES92/DNV00/BMI13 are dimensionless; the activity-normalised variant is the theoretically adjacent scaling; sign inconsistency = scaling noise, reject

causal_negative_control.name: OI-HP-28D-W-INV
causal_negative_control.falsification: any positive after-cost spread on the inverted book destroys the mechanism claim (would mean raw OI momentum pays, opposite pricing)

expected_sign: anchor net spread > 0 after native funding and adapter costs; neighbour same sign; inverted control <= 0
falsification_conditions: inverted control earns positive after-cost spread
A3 schedule-only cost gate FAIL or UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED
spread concentrated in one fold or one symbol (Stage-A concentration gates)
spread exists only when dOI is combined with price direction (trend proxy) -> reject; feature contract is OI-only
anchor positive while activity-scaled neighbour negative -> normalisation artifact, reject
Q-phase verification finds OI snapshot cadence/coverage below >=1 snapshot/day per universe symbol -> UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED, no scoring
funding_cost_treatment: native funding accrued LONG_PAYS_POSITIVE_RATE while held, pass-through only, never sorted or filtered on (keeps family separate from funding carry); costs via adapter rebalance_cost_between at baseline and fee x1.5 / +2-tick stressed cells; fail-closed on missing prices

ancestry_orthogonality.v10_m01: M01 consumed aggressor trade flow (executed volume prints, intraday); this family consumes the stock of open positions (OI) at weekly cadence — different data object, horizon, mechanism; A7-N rho vs M01 predeclared
ancestry_orthogonality.banned_families: not trend/momentum (no past-return feature; OI-only contract falsifiable); not reversal (no price-reversion term; A7-N vs weekly reversal predeclared); not volume-shock continuation (OI is position stock, not traded volume; bet is AGAINST build-up); not funding carry (funding pass-through only; characteristic is dOI); not crowding rescue (see is_rescue fields)
ancestry_orthogonality.reserved_seeds: seeds sort on residual return moments (vol, MAX/skew); this family sorts on a positioning quantity independent of the return distribution; predeclared A7-N rank-orthogonality rho gate rejects the family if it is indistinguishable from a lottery/low-vol proxy

data_readiness.required_fields: staged OI snapshot series, 15m completed bars, mark price, funding settlements (all in frozen snapshot); no new external data
data_readiness.coverage_risk: OI snapshot cadence/coverage per symbol NOT verified by this lane; Q phase must confirm >=1 snapshot/day over the scored window, else fail-closed UNAVAILABLE; stale-OI drop rule predeclared
data_readiness.implementation_estimate_days: 1.5-2.0 (GenericStrategyBase plugin + OI daily resample/HP feature module + PIT fixtures)

is_rescue_reasoning: no V1-V10 family in the provided lessons used open interest; M01 used aggressor flow (a flow primitive) and the banned funding-carry/crowding space used funding rates; the two disguised-identity paths (trend proxy via price-direction interaction; crowding/funding proxy) each have predeclared rejection tests (OI-only feature contract; funding pass-through-only rule; A7-N orthogonality rho)
